The Large Steam Furnace is the bronze base's smelting workhorse — one machine for a whole row of single furnaces. It re-prices “8 EU/t smelting” into a steam bill, and the whole story is parallelism and discounts.

Bronze runs §124 parallels, 0.6 EUt discount, duration ÷2.5§r — about §6115.2 L/t ≈ 2,300 L/s§r; steel §148 parallels, 0.4, ÷5§r — §6153.6 L/t ≈ 3,072 L/s§r.

§cTrust no old manual's “48,000 L/s” — that is the 20.8-fold accident of reading L/t as L/s; redo the math and the ledger turns clean.§r

§8§oNumbers speak, but only in the right units.§r
